analysis:
Examined both files' metadata, patches and all supplied surrounding reference text. changelog.d/ssd-maintenance-header-verdicts.md:3-9 describes memoizing readable maintenance headers. docs/reference/ssd-kv-cache.md:372 (head patch) specifies device/inode/size/mtime/ctime invalidation, per-fanout directory rechecks and no caching of failed reads. These documentation changes do not independently establish a security regression or change authorization, attestation, wire encryption, billing, cache scope or payload authentication. The stated TTL and budget policies remain unchanged (base reference:370-379), consistent with T-041's accessible-volume retention limits and accepted same-account timing risk.
Integration must verify the actual SSDWholeRootMaintainer.swift implementation of readableHeaderIdentities and fanoutPassesReadChecks: cached verdicts must not bypass descriptor-relative no-follow traversal, private directory/ACL and pinned-volume validation, nor authorize deletion after file replacement. Check cache lifetime/pruning, concurrent hit/write/removal behavior, and interaction with SSDNoFollowIO.swift, CacheStorage.swift and owned retirement/epoch checks described at reference:376-378. A readable maintenance header must remain distinct from authenticated payload/manifest admission and routing-ready evidence (reference:121,127,233-234). Runtime source and tests are absent from this batch, so the documented preservation of those controls is an unverified contract, not evidence of safety or a missing control. No supported finding in the supplied documentation; implementation verification remains material to T-041, A-001 and TB-007.
